title: Impact of Institutional Ownership on Firm Value

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
To assess whether increased institutional ownership affects firm value, we will use an Instrumental Variables (IV) approach. The S&P 500 inclusion status (z) serves as an instrument for institutional ownership (x). This approach is suitable because inclusion in the S&P 500 index can serve as an exogenous shock to institutional ownership, affecting firm value indirectly through its impact on ownership. The key assumption is the exclusion restriction: S&P 500 inclusion affects firm value only through changes in institutional ownership, not directly.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(AER)

# Load the data
data_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s80_data.csv"
df <- read.csv(data_path)

# Instrumental Variables (IV) Regression
iv_model <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | z + controls, data = df)

# Summarize the IV regression results
summary(iv_model)

# Conduct basic robustness checks: over-identification test (Sargan test)
sargan_test <- function(model) {
  u_hat <- residuals(model)
  IVs <- as.matrix(model$inst)
  GMM_objective <- t(u_hat) %*% IVs %*% solve(t(IVs) %*% IVs) %*% t(IVs) %*% u_hat / nrow(IVs)
  df_test <- ncol(IVs) - (ncol(model$model) - 1) # Over-identification degrees of freedom
  p_value <- pchisq(GMM_objective, df = df_test, lower.tail = FALSE)
  return(p_value)
}

# Print the Sargan test p-value
p_val <- sargan_test(iv_model)
print(paste("Sargan test p-value:", p_val))
```

## 3. Expected Findings
The expected sign of the coefficient on institutional ownership (x) is ambiguous without specific industry or firm context. However, economic theory suggests that higher institutional ownership might lead to better monitoring and alignment of management with shareholder interests, potentially increasing firm value. Hence, we might expect a positive coefficient. The magnitude would depend on industry-specific factors and the degree of institutional influence, but a moderate effect would be reasonable if institutional monitoring is effective. Given the instrumental variable approach using S&P 500 inclusion, we expect the instrument to be relevant and strong, resulting in a clear and statistically significant estimation if assumptions hold.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use S&P 500 inclusion as an instrument for institutional ownership.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Increased institutional ownership, driven by index inclusion, leads to a decrease in firm value.
